name: DataFlow
description: Animated governance/data-movement diagram with staged system cards, SVG edges, classification banners, optional legend, and callouts.

title.description: Optional scene title shown above the flow.

mode.description: Layout mode for node placement. Use linear for left-to-right flows, mesh for grid-like topologies, hub for converging signals.

stages.description: Native stage objects. Compiler serializes to stagesJson when stagesJson is absent.

edges.description: Native edge objects. Compiler serializes to edgesJson when edgesJson is absent.

legend.description: Native legend object. Compiler serializes to legendJson when legendJson is absent.

callouts.description: Native callout objects. Compiler serializes to calloutsJson when calloutsJson is absent.

stagesJson.description: JSON-encoded stages. Prefer native stages in new SCF authoring.

edgesJson.description: JSON-encoded edges. Prefer native edges in new SCF authoring.

legendJson.description: JSON-encoded legend. Prefer native legend in new SCF authoring.

calloutsJson.description: JSON-encoded callouts. Prefer native callouts in new SCF authoring.

qualityNotes: Use stable stage ids; every edge.from and edge.to must match a stage id.
Keep labels short enough for node cards; use callouts for detail.
Do not use AI image generation for diagrams; this component renders exact labels and arrows.
